metadata.notes: Evolving operational sub-cluster (TLCTC-XX.YY) catalogue — companion to the frozen Layer-1 strategic core. Seeded with the four reference decompositions; the six open clusters and any refinements are community-extensible. Machine-readable twin of documentation/tlctc-operational-enumeration.md.

sub_clusters.name: Core function vector
sub_clusters.examples: SQL injection through the application's query parser.

sub_clusters.name: External handler vector
sub_clusters.examples: Flaw in a server-side PHP engine or Apache module.

sub_clusters.name: Mechanical vector
sub_clusters.definition: Physical contact with matter (tampering, theft, intrusion into secure areas).

sub_clusters.name: Signal vector
sub_clusters.definition: Energy propagation with no direct contact (electromagnetic side-channels/TEMPEST, acoustic, environmental).

sub_clusters.name: Update vector
sub_clusters.examples: Compromised software update pushed to customers (e.g. SolarWinds 2020 at the trust acceptance event).

sub_clusters.name: Development vector
sub_clusters.examples: Backdoor injected into a build pipeline or a malicious library dependency.
